messages:
Carla - Release Eng: deploy-bot paused promotion for v2.3.0 — CI verify failed: artifact checksum differs across cache nodes. Holding change window (14:00 PT).

deploy-bot: Promo paused: release=v2.3.0; reason=cache_checksum_drift; key=artifacts/2026/03/26/v2.3.0.tar.gz; attempts=2; last_err='sha1 mismatch: expected=9f8e7d6c got=1a2b3c4d'

Ben (infra): quick check shows node-a returns expected hash, node-b returns different hash but same content-length. Likely cache corruption on node-b.

Alice M.: we have customer release notes and a scheduled rollout. Options: pin to v2.3.0-laststable, wait for infra fix, or reupload. I'm leaning to pin and run smoke.

Emma QA: laststable passed full smoke earlier. If we pin, I'll run a 5-minute canary smoke and sanity checks.

Ben (infra): I'll open ticket STOR-309 and kick a reupload to node-b. If pin approved, I'll run promote from laststable and track reconciliation.

Carla - Release Eng: approve pin. deploy-bot suggested_action=pin to artifact=artifacts/2026/03/25/v2.3.0-laststable.tar.gz. Run `deploy-bot confirm-pin v2.3.0-laststable` to proceed.

deploy-bot: pin confirmed; promoting artifact artifacts/2026/03/25/v2.3.0-laststable.tar.gz to release=v2.3.0.

Emma QA: canary smoke started post-promote — will report in ~6m.

Ben (infra): ticket STOR-309 created: https://tracker/internal/STOR-309 assigned infra-storage. Reupload running.

Carla - Release Eng: added short note to release draft: "artifact pinned to last stable build due to cache-node checksum drift; infra reconciling (STOR-309)." Scheduling announcement.

deploy-bot: promote job complete -> SUCCESS; promoted_artifact=artifacts/2026/03/25/v2.3.0-laststable.tar.gz

Emma QA: canary smoke passed. signing off. :rocket:

Carla - Release Eng: closing thread. Follow-ups: infra to finish STOR-309 and add a gating rule for multi-node checksum agreement.
